notes.title: 2018.04.26 Update
notes.content:
Hello!

Today, we made some small adjustments based on feedback from players.

- Fixed an install problem for 32 bit computers.
- Reduced the amount of stress level increase from Dorothy’s real life events.
- Decreased the probability of “Depression and Delusion” eventline.

Thanks for everyone who plays this game:)

notes.title: 2018.04.20 Update
notes.content:
Hello!

We solved a bug that stopped whole game from playing, when the Steam Client was running in offline mode or when the internet connection was cut off during the play.

Now you can play offline without any problems.

Thanks for everyone who plays this game:)
